description: Defines the TlsChloExtractor class for extracting information from QUIC-TLS Client Hello messages, including parsing packets, handling TLS handshake details, and interfacing with QUIC stream and framer components.

classes.name: TlsChloExtractor
classes.description: Utility class for extracting and parsing QUIC-TLS Client Hello messages, managing TLS handshake state, and interfacing with QUIC packet processing.

methods.name: IngestPacket
methods.description: Processes a received packet to extract the Client Hello (CHLO) message.

methods.name: HasParsedFullChlo
methods.description: Checks if a complete CHLO has been successfully parsed.

methods.name: StateToString
methods.description: Converts the internal state enum to a human-readable string.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming CRYPTO frames during packet parsing.

methods.name: OnUnauthenticatedPublicHeader
methods.description: Handles the public header of an unauthenticated packet.

methods.name: OnDataAvailable
methods.description: Called when new data is available on the stream.
